items.question: The engine's RSI(9) entry vote fires long above 60 and short below 40 (partial 55/45), on 1-minute bars in one session and 3-minute bars in two others. The trader's only stated RSI rule is 'momentum intact while RSI(9) is above 60, exit below 40' on a 1-minute chart. What should the vote's levels be anchored to?

options.label: (a)
options.text: keep 60/40 and 55/45 on 1-minute bars as the trader's own rule; on 3-minute bars use the levels that mark the same market state, found by matching how often each is exceeded over the same minutes on closed bars; plus a parity test against the trader's chart; needs new per-resolution settings keys

options.label: (b)
options.text: re-anchor all levels to a chosen target firing share per session and resolution

options.label: (c)
options.text: fit the levels to maximise net expected value

options.label: (d)
options.text: keep 60/40 and 55/45 unchanged at every resolution

items.rationale: Only (a) makes every level trace to something the trader stated, and the settings then say what is true at each resolution. (b) invents a target share, (c) overfits and duplicates a planned vote-value study, (d) is cheaper but silently gives the vote a different meaning on 3-minute bars.
